transcript.text: Good morning, Major Alvarez. Before we finalize the outage calendar, I need to flag a hard constraint on the signal side. The communications annex has a vendor-supported UPS test scheduled for Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, immediately followed by a 30-minute generator-transfer test at 1500 with the signal shop present. This appointment is on our section's working schedule but hasn't been added to the battalion calendar yet. We'll need the annex taken offline for that full window — 1300 to 1530 on Wednesday — so whatever we do with the water plant maintenance, it can't overlap that period.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Major, I need to get a critical constraint on the table. The water-treatment contractor is available only Tuesday from 0900 to 1100, and the plant must have a 600-gallon water-truck backup arranged during that outage. I confirmed this with the contractor this morning — it's in the facilities email but hasn't been entered on the battalion maintenance calendar yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

commitments.detail: Arrange a 600-gallon water-truck backup supply for the water plant outage on Tuesday 0900-1100.
Publish water plant outage Tuesday 0900-1100 and communications annex outage Wednesday 1300-1530 as non-overlapping windows.
Confirm vendor-supported UPS test Wednesday 1300-1500 and generator-transfer test at 1500 with signal shop present, annex offline through 1530.
